content:
hello everyone!

sorry if this isn't the right channel for this sort of stuff, but a few people started finding this useful, so i figured i'd advertise it a bit.

i was frustrated at the (apparent? i might be wrong) absence of a unified symbol reference for lean, and i wrote lean-symb, a searchable and intuitive (enough) list of all allowed symbols, with their abbreviations, sorted by categories. i finally got the motivation to migrate it off of my personal website and onto a more neutral repository, so that more people can use it!

the categories are of course very opinionated, and i'm open to feedback. everything is statically generated from lean-vscode's abbreviations.json: you can find the scripts and the source here.

Looking forward to comments, questions, suggestions!

₍ᐢᐢ₎
